2. Set of Four Methods on Faulty Section

(i) All faultless states. 60. (ii) Have they all the same root roots as the faultless roots? (i)+(ii) Yes. (iii) These have the same root roots as the faultless roots. (iv) Are they all faultless states? (v) Faultless mind-produced matter has the same root roots as the faultless root, (but is) not faultless (state). (iii)+(iv) Faultless (state) has the same root roots as the faultless root and is also faultless (state).

(i) All these states have the same root roots as the faultless roots. 61. (ii) Have they all mutual root roots with the faultless roots? (i)+(ii) These faultless root roots, which arise together, have both the same root roots as the mutual root roots. The remaining ones, which are conascent with the faultless root roots, have the same root roots as the faultless roots but no mutual roots. (iii) These have mutual root roots with the faultless roots. (iv) Are they all faultless states? (iii)+(iv) Yes. (4)
